subject: general
question: Which Indian ministry will support the Indian component of the €15.2 million joint initiative launched by India and the EU to strengthen EV battery recycling?

options.text: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Heavy Industries**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Government of India** and the **European Union (EU)** launched a **€15.2 million (~₹169 crore)** joint initiative to strengthen **EV Battery Recycling** on **5 May 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The initiative operates with a combined funding pool of **€15.2 million (~₹169 crore)**.
 
• The European side of the initiative will be funded through the **EU’s Horizon Europe programme**.
 
• The Indian component of the joint initiative will be exclusively supported by the **Ministry of Heavy Industries (MHI)**. Hence, **Ministry of Heavy Industries** is the correct answer.
 
• The programme will focus on developing advanced recycling technologies, including high-efficiency material recovery, and establishing a **joint India-EU pilot line in India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The initiative was launched under the framework of the **India-EU Trade & Technology Council (TTC) - Working Group 2** on **Green and Clean Energy Technologies**.
 
• The submission deadline for the proposals regarding this initiative is set for **15 September 2026**.
 
• The call for proposals will focus specifically on critical minerals like **lithium, graphite, and cobalt**.
 
• The overarching goals include securing critical raw materials, accelerating the global transition to a circular economy, and strengthening bilateral relations between **India and the EU**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Prof. Ajay Kumar Sood**, Principal Scientific Adviser to the Government of India, highlighted that creating a robust domestic recycling ecosystem is essential for India's **resource security** and **environmental commitments**.
 
• **Dr. Parvinder Maini** noted that this model aims to pioneer a digitalized, inclusive logistics setup that integrates the **informal sector** while maintaining high safety standards for **second-life applications**.
